notes.title: FULL Prologue + Chapter 1 now FREE as a Demo!
notes.content:
[b]​Hi everyone!
[/b]
It's finally here, I promised a bigger demo and here it is! I call it a demo but it is the FULL Prologue and Chapter 1 of the game so it is a big chunck of the final content.

​Download it here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822660/KOTOMASHO_I_Cant_Believe_This_NEET_Guy_Turned_Into_a_Magical_Girl/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822660/KOTOMASHO_I_Cant_Believe_This_NEET_Guy_Turned_Into_a_Magical_Girl/[/url]

I am launching a Kickstarter campaign on January 31, so, if you enjoyed the game or if you are interested, please go ahead and sign up on the pre-launch page to get notified at launch and share with friends, family and social media. Every bit of help either by donating or sharing is greatly appreciated.
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/walgallen/kotomasho-a-gameboy-color-inspired-adventure-rpg/]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/walgallen/kotomasho-a-gameboy-color-inspired-adventure-rpg/
[/url]

[previewyoutube=q77zm_6XI60;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's a list of the changes and future additions:

[i][b]Upgrades, Fixes & Additions:
[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] 3 New Enemies
[*] New Magic Power
[*] Special Powers (Only Remote Detonators available on Chapter 1)
[*] New Cave Dungeon
[*] New Dungeon
[*] New Boss
[*] Anime Style Eyecatch
[*] Mini Overworld
[*] Map
[*] Push & Pull Mechanic
[*] Buttons
[*] Battle Rooms
[*] Controller Support
[*] More Story
[*] Upgrades
[*] Shop
[*] Treasure Chests
[*] New Town
[*] Tons of new Songs
[/list]

[i][b]Future Additions Planned:
[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Magical Girl Anime Transformation Sequence
[*] Current Objective Marker
[*] Proper Overworld
[*] More Puzzle Mechanics
[*] More Dungeons
[*] More Towns
[*] More Dialogue Portrait Expressions
[/list]

If you want to check weekly updates feel free to follow me on Twitter@WalGallen​ or you can stay in touch by joining my community on Discord​!

I'll see you on the next one! 🌟

- WalGallen

notes.title: Update 0.16a Changelog
notes.content:
​Sup Everyone! This minor update is all about eye candy. Most changes involve either adding or improving the game's art assets and animations.

Here's the changelog:

[h2][b]Added:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Small particles to all projectiles when dissapearing.
[*] Pull animation when the player is colliding with a wall.
[*] Pause and Unpause SFX
[/list]

[h2][b]Upgrades:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Now the player and enemy proyectiles cancel each other when colliding.
[*] Overhauled the Tree design, added animation and bigger trees.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Minor fixes with shadows, tile backgrounds and image layering
[*] Removed the Gameboy overlay because it was too distracting
[/list]

There's tons more of changes but I'm keeping those secret until the big 2.0 update! Stay tuned for more Updates on Twitter or Instagram @WalGallen or keep closely in touch by joining my community on Discord

See you on the next one! 🌟

- WalGallen

notes.title: Update 0.15a Changelog
notes.content:
Sup Everyone! I found a couple more bugs and there were a few improvements that were recommended to me. It's not too much but I thought it would be necesary to update just in case.

Here's the changelog:

[h2][b]Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]The File Select scene played music at full volume even when setting as at 0.
[*]The Savefile in Slot 1 was loaded even when Selecting or Making a new game on another file.
[/list]

[h2][b]Upgrades:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]The Exit Button in Pause Menu was changed to a button that Returns to the Main Menu
[*]Added a "Saving..." message and Save Icon when saving the game from the Pause Menu.
[/list]

And that's it for now! Stay tuned for more Updates on Twitter or Instagram @WalGallen or keep closely in touch by joining my community on Discord

See you on the next one! 🌟

- WalGallen
